variants.title: 넓은 가슴형
variants.detail: Variant — BROAD CHEST GUARDIAN. A's shoulders and chest become more square and broad, chest about 20 percent wider relative to head than A while head stays same large charming proportion. Dense continuous torso depth, flat firm short abdomen, short balanced thick arms and broad fists. Natural upper arms visibly support wide shoulders, not separate armor caps. Stocky sturdy short legs and broad squared feet. Strong upright quiet presence, width mainly in chest/shoulders. Preserve A face and head silhouette closely.
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / identity-preserve. RuneNexus HIGH-HP UNARMORED HUMANOID TANK exploration, not in-game render. Image1 is the USER FAVORITE A guardian and must be the main design basis. Preserve recognizable large round-chamfered stone head, broad natural shoulders, chunky short arms and legs, stone fists/feet, inset turquoise round eyes, turquoise forehead spiral carved directly in head stone, exactly one recessed amber chest core, weathered warm gray-brown stone. Image2 is actual NORMAL guardian for same-family reference and SIZE CONTEXT. Make a variant of A, not a tiny-headed athletic human. NO pot belly, no obese shape, no armor/helmet/metal/robot joints/clothing/shield/weapon. Natural dense stone anatomy; no pauldron-looking shell. Short robust humanoid, large head around third of height. Render broad readable planes and tactile natural stone, subtle contained eye/rune/core light.
Composition: ONE LANDSCAPE clean studio concept plate showing ONLY TWO full-body characters, one dominant tank on RIGHT and the existing NORMAL guardian on LEFT, standing side-by-side on SAME FLOOR at SAME camera distance, same gentle three-quarter orthographic viewing angle facing lower-left, no foreground/background perspective size trick. The tank's TOTAL visible head-to-sole HEIGHT must be approximately 1.5 TIMES the normal's. Normal reaches around two-thirds tank height. Tank does not have to be exactly 1.5 wider because its body proportions differ. Keep normal image2 identity: very large head, purple eyes/forehead rune/chest core, gray stone, dark small joint gaps, normal compact anatomy. Do not recolor normal or shrink its head. Tank is larger overall in all dimensions, not only enlarged arms. Tank occupies about 80% plate height, normal around 53%. Show heads/fists/feet with clear margins, no overlap. Plain dark desaturated navy-gray floor/backdrop, soft readable studio key/fill, restrained shadows. No numbers, text labels, UI, ruler, inset, tile, pedestal, scenery or particles. This is an approximate SCALE INTENT illustration, not a measurement chart. Absolute priority is favorite A identity, no fat abdomen, and clearly larger tank next to normal.
Variant — BROAD CHEST GUARDIAN. A's shoulders and chest become more square and broad, chest about 20 percent wider relative to head than A while head stays same large charming proportion. Dense continuous torso depth, flat firm short abdomen, short balanced thick arms and broad fists. Natural upper arms visibly support wide shoulders, not separate armor caps. Stocky sturdy short legs and broad squared feet. Strong upright quiet presence, width mainly in chest/shoulders. Preserve A face and head silhouette closely.

variants.title: 굵은 팔형
variants.detail: Variant — HEAVY ARM GUARDIAN. Preserve A large round-chamfered head and compact non-fat torso but enlarge thick forearms and blunt fists noticeably, around 25 percent more relative mass than A. Forearms solid stone taper gently toward enormous cuboid fists near mid-thigh, maintain clear space between arms and waist. Shoulders stay broad but lower than A. Very short dense stone legs and heavy feet. Upright stance, no crouch or knuckle walking. Dominant arm mass distinguishes this variant while face/head/body ratios unmistakably remain A.

variants.title: 단단한 각진형
variants.detail: Variant — HARD-EDGED GUARDIAN. Preserve A overall round-square LARGE head outline, stern face and chibi compact proportions, but sharpen broad bevels on brow/jaw, upper chest, forearms, fists and feet. Torso a solid broad trapezoid sculpted boulder with a flat continuous front and amber core, not paired pectoral spheres. Natural angular thick shoulders, stout short squared limbs. Head is not a perfect cube, stays clearly recognizable as A. Less rounded than A and stronger clean planes, no separate plates, stacked rock armor or shell. Compact upright defensive temperament.
